# Filers: Get Filer

Area overview and notes: [filers.md](../filers.md)

`GET /filers/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieves a filer by ID.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Filer. |

**Response 200**: Filer retrieved successfully.
